pages.title: Choosing a place
pages.instruction: Listen for the problem, the response and the next step

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: How about dinner on Friday? We could invite two friends
lines.audioText: How about dinner on Friday? We could invite two friends.
lines.translation: Que tal jantar na sexta? Poderíamos convidar duas amigas

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: That sounds good. Why don’t we try the River Café?
lines.audioText: That sounds good. Why don’t we try the River Café?
lines.translation: Parece bom. Por que não experimentamos o River Café?

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: It’s cheaper, but there are steps at the entrance. Is that a problem?
lines.audioText: It’s cheaper, but there are steps at the entrance. Is that a problem?
lines.translation: É mais barato, mas tem degraus na entrada. Isso é um problema?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: One friend needs step-free access. The Garden Table would be easier
lines.audioText: One friend needs step-free access. The Garden Table would be easier.
lines.translation: Uma amiga precisa de acesso sem degraus. O Garden Table seria mais fácil

questions.prompt: Why is the Garden Table a better fit for this group?

pages.title: Checking before booking
pages.instruction: Listen for the problem, the response and the next step

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Good point. Shall we book for seven?
lines.audioText: Good point. Shall we book for seven?
lines.translation: Bem lembrado. Vamos reservar para as sete?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Yes. I’ll check everyone’s availability first
lines.audioText: Yes. I’ll check everyone’s availability first.
lines.translation: Sim. Vou conferir a disponibilidade de todos primeiro

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Thanks. I can book the table when they reply
lines.audioText: Thanks. I can book the table when they reply.
lines.translation: Obrigada. Posso reservar a mesa quando responderem

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Great. Let’s split the bill so it’s simple for everyone
lines.audioText: Great. Let’s split the bill so it’s simple for everyone.
lines.translation: Ótimo. Vamos dividir a conta para ficar simples para todos

questions.prompt: Why do they wait before booking?
questions.answer: They need to check everyone’s availability

pages.instruction: Connect the meaning, the form and the example

rows.subject: Propose a shared action
rows.verb: Why don’t we + verb? / Let’s + verb
rows.example: Why don’t we book a table? Let’s check first

rows.subject: Respond and offer an alternative
rows.verb: That sounds … / I’d love to, but …
rows.example: I’d love to, but I can’t on Friday. How about Saturday?

pages.title: Plan the whole evening
pages.instruction: Invite me, agree on a place and confirm the plan

pages.title: A friend can only come on Saturday
pages.instruction: Listen for the new information and decide how to respond
pages.message: Hi, Ana! I heard from our friends. One of them can’t come on Friday, but everyone is free on Saturday at eight. We still need step-free access, and twenty dollars each is OK. Could you change the date before you book? The Garden Table has a table on Saturday. Let me know what you decide, and I’ll send the invitation
pages.audioText: Hi, Ana! I heard from our friends. One of them can’t come on Friday, but everyone is free on Saturday at eight. We still need step-free access, and twenty dollars each is OK. Could you change the date before you book? The Garden Table has a table on Saturday. Let me know what you decide, and I’ll send the invitation.

items.answer: We need to change Friday to Saturday at eight and keep step-free access
